016package org.vafer.jdeb.producers;
017
018import java.io.IOException;
019import org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarArchiveEntry;
020import org.vafer.jdeb.DataConsumer;
021import org.vafer.jdeb.DataProducer;
022import org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.Mapper;
023
024/**
025 * DataProducer representing a single file
026 * For cross-platform permissions and ownerships you probably want to use a Mapper, too.
027 */
028public final class DataProducerLink
029  extends AbstractDataProducer
030  implements DataProducer
031{
032
033  private final String path;
034  private final String linkName;
035  private final boolean symlink;
036
037  public DataProducerLink(
038    final String path,
039    final String linkName,
040    final boolean symlink,
041    String[] pIncludes,
042    String[] pExcludes,
043    Mapper[] pMapper
044  ) {
045    super(pIncludes, pExcludes, pMapper);
046    this.path = path;
047    this.symlink = symlink;
048    this.linkName = linkName;
049  }
050
051  public void produce(final DataConsumer pReceiver) throws IOException {
052    TarArchiveEntry entry = new TarArchiveEntry(
053      path,
054      symlink ? TarArchiveEntry.LF_SYMLINK : TarArchiveEntry.LF_LINK
055    );
056    entry.setLinkName(linkName);
057
058    entry.setUserId(Producers.ROOT_UID);
059    entry.setUserName(Producers.ROOT_NAME);
060    entry.setGroupId(Producers.ROOT_UID);
061    entry.setGroupName(Producers.ROOT_NAME);
062    entry.setMode(TarArchiveEntry.DEFAULT_FILE_MODE);
063
064    entry = map(entry);
065
066    entry.setName(path);
067    entry.setLinkName(linkName);
068
069    pReceiver.onEachLink(entry);
070  }
071}
